blocks.title: Start from last year's exam
blocks.text: Most JABSOM assessments are built by duplicating the previous year's exam. That keeps question order, categorization, and scoring setup intact.

items.d: Name it with the academic year.
Items the course no longer teaches or that performed badly.
Every new question needs at least one category.
Confirm point values and partial credit settings.
7 business days before the exam. Use the checklist below.

blocks.text: Exam review controls whether students see the questions and their answers after submitting. You choose the setting. OME applies it when posting the exam.

rows: Questions and answers right after uploading
Formative quizzes where fast feedback matters
Questions and answers after a date you set
Summative exams where you need time to review item analysis first
When the item bank must stay secure

blocks.title: Decide the review setting before handoff
blocks.text: The setting cannot be changed after the exam is posted. Tell OME your choice when you hand off the draft.
Verify 'exam review cannot be changed after posting' against the transcript or the Legacy articles.
Before you hand off, confirm each of these:

items: Every question has at least one category.
Question order and vignette groups are in the sequence you want.
Point values and partial credit settings are confirmed.
Images students need on the printed backup are embedded, not attached.
You have picked an exam review setting: Immediate, Delayed (with a date), or None.

blocks.text: Then tell OME the draft is ready and which review setting you chose. OME posts the exam. Do not post it yourself unless OME asks.

Say exactly how to hand off: who to email (preclerk@? Jesse?) and whether to share the assessment or just send its name. The help page routes 'Draft handoff' to 'OME pre-clerkship staff' with no address.
